tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Show scheduled tasks, next run times, run counts, and measured platform cost metadata. User charge is $0.00 during the beta.

tools.name: get_task_runs
tools.description: Recent runs of one scheduled task: what it returned, whether the result changed, and measured platform cost metadata. User charge is $0.00.

tools.description: Stop and remove a scheduled task and its run history.

tools.name: china_reachability
tools.description: Fetch a URL from a real mainland-China network egress and report HTTP status, latency and China DNS resolution. Answers "is my site/API usable from China?" with a measurement instead of a guess — you cannot get this from a VPS abroad.
